post_text:
Aman's first yacht will not sail until May 2027, yet its Caribbean winter of 2028 is already on sale.

@Aman at Sea has added twelve cruises to the programme of Amangati, from 2 January to 20 March 2028, each of five to eight nights.

The 180-metre yacht, built by T. Mariotti in Genoa and designed by Sinot Yacht Architecture & Design, has 47 suites for up to 94 guests. Its maiden voyage leaves Palma de Mallorca on 7 May 2027.

New calls include Samaná, Cap Cana and La Romana in the Dominican Republic, Saint-Pierre in Martinique, Marie-Galante and Bequia. A five-night cruise in March 2028 starts at €27,100 per suite.

On board: Akari, an omakase counter, Aman Grill, a jazz club and a two-level spa with a Japanese garden. Jonathan Wilson, President and CEO of Aman at Sea, leads the venture, run under licence from @Aman.

The signal: ultra-luxury hotel brands now treat the sea as one more address. Guests book the name first and the destination second.

Which hotel brand would you most like to see at sea next?
